name: Swift Service Request Summary
query:
SELECT
    name as "Request:Link/Swift Service Request:180",
    customer as "Customer:Link/Customer:180",
    complaint_type as "Complaint Type:Data:140",
    priority as "Priority:Data:100",
    status as "Status:Data:140",
    assigned_engineer as "Engineer:Link/User:180",
    modified as "Last Updated:Datetime:180"
FROM
    `tabSwift Service Request`
ORDER BY modified DESC
